dct_description_sm: The National Science Foundation (NSF) Ultraviolet (UV) Spectroradiometer Network was established in 1987 by the Division of Polar Programs in response to serious ozone depletion reported in Antarctica. Biospherical Instruments installed the first instruments in 1988. Observations were extended to the Arctic and are now part of NSF's Arctic Observing Network.
